top_five.text: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 2,000 people across five provinces with total confirmed cases exceeding 4,300.
A 7.4-magnitude earthquake in western Colombia killed at least 132 people and injured more than 480 following structural collapses in urban centres.
An Amnesty International report detailed foreign weapons supply chains supporting Israel's military operations in Gaza, where reported fatalities have surpassed 70,000 Palestinians.
Military junta airstrikes in Myanmar killed dozens of civilians and displaced persons across Rakhine State and Ayeyarwady Region.
Russian missile strikes targeting Zaporizhzhia killed at least six people and injured 19 others during ongoing aerial bombardments of Ukrainian infrastructure.

top_story.quote: An accelerating Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed over 2,000 lives across five provinces, with viral transmission outpacing current response capabilities.
top_story.label: AFRICA — DRC Ebola Outbreak

Middle East.headline: Gaza/Israel — Amnesty report details international arms links amid severe casualty figures
Middle East.body: An Amnesty International report reveals that India has become a key component in Israel's weapons supply chain during its military campaign in Gaza. According to report details cited by media, Israel's military campaign in Gaza has left the territory in ruins and resulted in the deaths of more than 70,000 Palestinians, including many children. The report highlights growing international scrutiny regarding foreign supply chains supporting military operations in the territory.

Middle East.headline: Yemen/Red Sea — Three crew members killed in Houthi attack in Bab el-Mandeb
Middle East.body: A maritime attack by Houthi forces in the Bab el-Mandeb strait resulted in the deaths of three crew members. The attack occurred as hostilities continue across the region involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. The fatal incident underscores the persistent security risks to commercial and humanitarian maritime transport navigating critical shipping lanes in the Red Sea and surrounding waters.

Middle East.headline: Syria — Displaced Kurdish families suspend return to Ras al-Ain after attacks
Middle East.body: Efforts to return displaced Syrian Kurds to the border town of Ras al-Ain, also known as Sere Kaniye, were suspended after returning families came under violent attack. Hundreds of displaced Syrians had joined the first organized convoy to return to their hometown after seven years of displacement. Following the security incidents, the United Nations stated that Syrian authorities remain responsible for securing the safe return of displaced families.
verified_figures: Hundreds of Syrian Kurds displaced for 7 years

Americas.headline: Colombia — Major 7.4-magnitude earthquake causes mass casualties and building collapses
Americas.body: A 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia at 7:34 a.m. local time on Monday, with its epicentre located in the western department of Chocó. The tremor caused severe structural damage and building collapses in major urban centres, including Cali and Pereira, and was felt in neighbouring Venezuela. At least 132 people have been killed and more than 480 others injured. Search and rescue operations are continuing amid fears that additional victims remain trapped beneath collapsed structures.

Africa.headline: DRC — Ebola outbreak death toll surpasses 2,000
Africa.body: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed over 2,000 lives, marking it as one of the fastest-spreading outbreaks on record. Health authorities have confirmed a total of 4,381 cases across five provinces as of Tuesday. The rapid transmission of the virus continues to test response capacities and humanitarian support systems across the country's affected regions.

Europe.headline: Ukraine — Russian missile strikes kill six in Zaporizhzhia
Europe.body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that recent Russian missile strikes targeting Zaporizhzhia involved North Korean ballistic missiles. According to reports, the bombardment killed at least six people and injured 19 others. The attack forms part of ongoing Russian aerial strikes hitting Ukrainian urban areas and critical infrastructure across the country.

Europe.headline: Russia — Ukrainian drone strike on oil refinery kills 13
Europe.body: A Ukrainian long-range drone strike hit the Taneco oil refinery in Nizhnekamsk, located approximately 1,200 kilometres inside Russia. According to the local mayor, the attack killed at least 13 people. The strike marks one of the deadliest Ukrainian attacks deep within Russian territory as Kyiv continues targeting energy and industrial infrastructure.

Europe.headline: Germany — Explosive drone strikes Ukrainian aircraft at NATO logistics hub
Europe.body: An explosive-laden quadcopter drone passed undetected through air defence systems and struck a Ukrainian cargo plane at Germany's Leipzig/Halle Airport, a major NATO airlift hub. The device failed to detonate and was recovered from the tarmac four hours later. Investigators linked DNA evidence from the drone to a previous incendiary device incident at the same facility in July 2024.

Asia-Pacific.headline: Myanmar — Military airstrikes kill civilians and displaced persons in Rakhine and Ayeyarwady
Asia-Pacific.body: Military airstrikes in Myanmar have caused significant civilian casualties across multiple regions. In Thandwe Township, Rakhine State, aerial attacks killed dozens of civilians, injured eight people, and left two missing. In a separate incident in Ayeyarwady Region, a military junta airstrike killed two displaced brothers in an area already affected by severe flooding. The strikes highlight severe ongoing protection risks for civilians and internally displaced populations trapped between armed conflict and adverse weather conditions.
verified_figures: Dozens of civilians killed in Thandwe
2 displaced brothers killed in Ayeyarwady Region

Asia-Pacific.headline: China — Typhoon Dolphin causes mass displacement and inland flooding
Asia-Pacific.body: Typhoon Dolphin has struck eastern China before moving inland, causing extensive flooding and triggering mass emergency evacuations across central provinces including Hubei. Reports indicate that up to one million people have been evacuated to escape severe floodwaters. The storm has disrupted major transport networks and cancelled hundreds of flights across eastern regions. As rainfall progresses inland, municipal authorities in Beijing have placed the capital on alert for heavy torrential rains.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: Global — Undetected Ebola outbreak kills over 2,000 as spread outpaces response
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: According to the World Health Organization, an Ebola outbreak began in February, spreading undetected for three months prior to its official declaration. The WHO chief stated that the spread of the disease is currently outpacing response efforts. The outbreak has killed over 2,000 people as total reported deaths continue to rise.

escalation_risks.trigger: Further maritime strikes on commercial shipping by Houthi forces could trigger wider military responses and halt critical shipping lines.
escalation_risks.potential_impact: Disruptions to regional maritime transit could severely impede humanitarian logistics and commercial supply chains across the Red Sea.

escalation_risks.trigger: Continued security incidents targeting returnee convoys could lead to a total collapse of organized civilian returns to northern Syria.
escalation_risks.potential_impact: Hundreds of long-term displaced families will remain stranded without secure passage or access to their home communities.

escalation_risks.trigger: Continued inland movement of Typhoon Dolphin bringing torrential rain to central provinces could overwhelm local river systems and urban drainage.
escalation_risks.potential_impact: Additional major flooding could force further mass evacuations beyond the one million people already displaced and exacerbate transport network disruptions.
